t: A card game that shows how recommendation algorithms use personal information.
steps: Find the #ForYou game page on the MediaSmarts site.
Download the game cards and the optional scoring tokens.
Print at least one set of cards.
Read the lesson plan and the discussion guide.
Plan the time. A search snippet lists 75 minutes for the game and 2.5 hours with assessment.
Check that the page you found is the right game.
